features.title: Python-first application
features.desc: Create an application instance and configure optional verbose logging. The App object is the entry point for registering bot behavior.
features.code:
from yappy import App

bot = App(verbose=True)

features.title: Event handlers
features.desc: Register an asynchronous callback for an event such as an incoming message. The current starter interface passes a context object to the callback.

features.title: Command registration
features.desc: Use the command decorator to register a named command and provide a human-readable description.

features.title: Context and core models
features.desc: The current implementation includes Context, Message, Channel, and User models to represent common objects used while handling bot interactions.

features.title: Context-based replies
features.desc: Reply to a message from a handler through the context object, keeping the interaction code concise.
features.code:
async def on_message(ctx):
    await ctx.reply("Thanks for your message!")

features.title: Optional verbose logging
features.desc: Enable verbose output when creating the application to help inspect behavior during development.

features.title: Embeds
features.code:
import yappy
bot = yappy.App(verbose=True)
@bot.command(
  name="send_embed"
  description
)
async def send_embed(ctx):
  embed = yappy.Embed("title")
  embed.add_field("Test Field", "1")
  embed.add_footer("My Footer")
  await ctx.reply(embeds=[embed])
